messages:
maria-recruiter: Candidate Marco L. (ex-Azure infra) verbally accepted verbal offer contingent on comp exception. Role: Principal Platform Eng. Asking for +20k base above band max due to market counter and RSU stagnation. Wants start 2026-06-01 but can move earlier if needed. Need routing + decision within 72h.
kevin-peopleops: Please paste current band, requested comp, and any proposed structure (base vs sign-on vs equity refresh). Also flag if immigration or background will affect start date.
anya-hiringmgr: Marco is critical for our observability rewrite. I back a larger package. Prefer combining base bump + a one-time retention RSU grant if that helps approvals.
maria-recruiter: Comp snapshot:
```
Band range: 140,000 - 155,000 (band mid 147,500)
Initial offer intended: 155,000 (band max)
Candidate asks: 175,000 base (+20k) OR 10k base + 10k sign-on + 20k RSU one-time retention
Equity: current offer RSU 40k over 4y; candidate requests 60k one-time retention vested 1/yr
```
Market comp doc: https://internal-comp/redwood/platform-2026.pdf
benefits-team: Heads up on 401(k) eligibility: new hires become eligible on first payroll after 30 days. Also PTO accrual starts day one for exempt roles. If start moves earlier we can share pro-rated relocation planning.
kevin-peopleops: Noted. Any visa/immigration?
maria-recruiter: Candidate is US-based, no visa. Background MVR and reference checks pending.
linda-cfo: My delegated authority covers up to +10k base. Anything over that needs exec approval (Ben). If we can structure as 10k base + sign-on + RSU retention, I can greenlight finance for the package. Need 3-year run-rate delta and headcount confirmation.
anya-hiringmgr: Headcount confirmed from product Q3 plan. I can accept 10k base + 10k sign-on + 20k one-time RSU vested quarterly over 1 year.
legal: For the RSU ad-hoc grant we'll need the one-time award paperwork and exec sign-off on grant size. Also ensure payroll has tax withholding guidance on sign-on split.
kevin-peopleops: OK proposal to take to comp committee at 3pm: 10k base bump, 10k sign-on (50/50 split), 20k one-time RSU retention (1yr cliff/then quarterly). Relocation: candidate asked for 6k travel stipend if needed. Shared rationale included.
ben-cto: If the committee flags the larger base bump we should preserve long-term incentives via RSUs. I will review and sign if people-ops and finance align on the split.
offer-bot: Offer workflow OFF-12211 created. Current approvals pending: people-ops, finance, exec (if escalated), legal for RSU paperwork.
kevin-peopleops: Comp committee approved the proposed mixed package but requested finance confirm run-rate impact. Routing to finance now. ETA 2 hours.
linda-cfo: Finance approves the mixed package within delegated authority. Exec sign-off not required given RSU is one-time and base bump within my limit. Please include 3-year cost summary in Workday packet.
maria-recruiter: Candidate said they'd accept 10k base + 10k sign-on with RSU retention. Wants sign-on in two payments: 50% at start, 50% after 6 months. Start date preferred 6/1, can do 5/15 if we need earlier.
kevin-peopleops: Please add onboarding checklist item for RSU admin and tax guidance. Benefits noted re: 401(k). Background check expected to clear in 48h.
offer-bot: OFF-12211 status -> sent to candidate; waiting on signed docs.
maria-recruiter: Sent offer packet with sign-on split and RSU addendum. Holding for candidate sign.
kevin-peopleops: Update: signed offer received. Start date set to 2026-05-15 per candidate preference. Thanks all; closing loop.
anya-hiringmgr: Welcome Marco! Adding to #platform-onboard and assigning buddy.
benefits-team: Filing relocation stipend and 401(k) enrollment steps.
kevin-peopleops: Closing thread. If any follow-ups on RSU tax or payroll issues ping payroll or legal.
